title: Backend/Integration Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Backend/Integration Developer who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities):

  • Develop and enhance BigCommerce-based B2B eCommerce solutions with features like custom pricing, account management, and multi-level user roles.
  • Implement advanced B2B functionalities such as bulk ordering, reordering, and request-for-quote (RFQ) processes.
  • Hands on experience in customizing checkout and enhancing payment capabilities.
  • Experience in handling shipping providers integrations.
  • Customize workflows for B2B-specific needs like tax exemptions, volume discounts, and credit limits.
  • Work with BigCommerce APIs, webhooks, and graphQL to develop robust integrations for seamless data flow.
  • Work on headless BigCommerce implementations and ensure seamless integration with CMS or custom front ends.
  • Work in an agile team, committing to estimates and delivering within fixed sprints.
  • Collaborate with technical leads & solutions architects for aspects related to integrations with other systems.


Mandatory Skills

  • Advanced English
  • Strong proficiency with the BigCommerce platform, including the Stencil framework, Storefront APIs, and BigCommerce Admin API.
  • Hands-on experience with B2B functionalities, including customer groups, advanced pricing rules, and catalog segmentation.
  • Familiarity with features like multi-user accounts, role-based permissions, and advanced reporting for B2B buyers.
  • Knowledge of B2B payment methods, shipping methods, and tax compliance requirements.
  • Expertise in front-end development: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), and frameworks like react.
  • Proficiency in server-side technologies like Node.js is plus.
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems such as Salesforce and SAP.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams and work on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • The ability and drive to research and solve problems.
  • Excellent communication skills.


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

Health insurance

Childcare assistance

TotalPass

International experience opportunity

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform

title: Assistente de Conteúdo PCD (Catálogo, E-commerce)
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 155 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.


Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.



Descrição Resumida


Registrar e manter atualizado, o cadastro dos dados de produtos de menor complexidade oferecidos nas lojas, inserindo os itens relacionados aos sistemas automotivos, por veículo, ano e tipo, complementando com dados dos fornecedores, representantes, entre outros, visando a segurança e qualidade das informações processadas para utilização pelas lojas na venda de produtos.


Responsabilidades

  • Zelar pela integridade dos dados cadastrados, auditando sua procedência por meio de pesquisas na Internet e informações das áreas internas, conforme padrões de segurança definidos pela Matriz.
  • Informar as áreas internas sobre eventuais divergências nos dados e solicitar as correções necessárias.
  • Auxiliar na geração e atualização do catálogo eletrônico de peças hard parts , incluindo aplicações por modelo de veículo, características e imagens dos produtos.
  • Enviar o catálogo atualizado para a equipe do México para inserção no sistema.
  • Receber e analisar informações enviadas pelas lojas, via sistema, para identificar necessidades de inclusão ou atualização de produtos a serem disponibilizados no portfólio.


Qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Conhecimento no pacote office.
  • Diferencial: inglês.


Informações Adicionais

  • Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido - Vila Leopoldina/SP
  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.


Valorizamos a diversidade e promovemos ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.

description:
Incentivamos candidaturas diversas e estamos comprometidos com um ambiente que promove inclusão e respeito.




Sinta a nossa energia!

Somos um time de 16 mil colaboradores próprios, espalhados por 18 estados brasileiros e no Distrito Federal. Aqui, os sotaques se misturam, integração, colaboração e segurança são elementos fundamentais em nosso dia a dia. Sua energia será muito importante para

Garantir a distribuição, inspeção, ligação e religação da rede elétrica juntamente com equipe que atende o setor.




Atividades

  • Executar serviços de manejo de vegetação em redes de média tensão e baixa tensão, seguindo os normativos de segurança e procedimentos de meio ambiente;

  • Executar manobras em chaves e equipamentos de subestações e linhas de transmissão e de redes, através de bloqueio de sistemas de proteção, abertura de chaves e disjuntores e repasse de informações necessárias para a realização da manobra, sob supervisão, orientação e controle do Centro de Operação da Distribuição e do Sistema.

  • Ensino médio completo;

title: Especialista em Suporte SAP FICO - Híbrido
description:
igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos


Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.


  • Advanced English


Role Summary:


Lead L3 functional support for SAP FICO & Central Finance (CFIN). Manage complex incidents, financial posting issues, CFIN replication errors, and ensure stable, accurate, and compliant financial operations across global business processes.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Act as L3 escalation point for SAP FICO/CFIN issues across GL, AP, AR, AA, CO, Banking


  • Troubleshoot complex CFIN SLT/AIF replication errors, mapping issues, and data mismatches


  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes & process improvements


  • Support financial closing cycles (month-end/quarter-end/year-end)


  • Analyze and resolve posting issues, reconciliation variances, and document splitting problems


  • Coordinate cross-functional integrations (MM, SD, HR, Concur, Treasury, External systems)


  • Handle change requests, impact analysis, regression testing, and release readiness


  • Review financial interfaces, IDocs, reports, and system controls

title: Senior Finance Data Analyst
description:
We’re building the future of how the world communicates.


What’s the scope of this role?

As part of Finance Global Business Support, the Senior Finance Data Analyst in the Business Profitability Management (BPM) group is responsible for delivering accurate, scalable, and actionable data products that support senior leadership decision-making. This role focuses on building and maintaining reporting, analytics, and dashboards for incoming deals and ongoing projects, ensuring transparency into bookings, revenue, margin, and profitability performance.

Will own data quality across source systems and reporting layers, create automated reporting solutions, and partner with Finance and Operations teams to identify trends, risks, and opportunities. This role blends financial understanding with strong technical and data skills to enable faster, more reliable forecasting and performance monitoring.


Responsibilities

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and recurring reporting for global bookings, revenue, margin, and profitability performance (Excel / Power BI / BI tools).
  • Own end-to-end reporting workflows including data extraction, transformation, modeling, validation, and distribution to executives and senior management.
  • Support monthly forecasting and actuals processes by delivering automated datasets, KPI tracking, and variance analytics (actual vs forecast vs prior periods).
  • Develop and maintain data models using Power Query, Power Pivot, and/or BI semantic models, ensuring consistent definitions and reconciliation with source systems.
  • Create executive-ready KPI decks and visual analytics; clearly communicate significant risks and drivers for bookings, revenue, and profit.
  • Partner globally with BPM managers/analysts and operational stakeholders to identify data issues, root causes, and required adjustments to properly reflect forecast and performance.
  • Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy and speed by implementing automation (Power Query, VBA, SQL, Power BI, workflows).
  • Define business requirements and support testing/implementation of ERP-based automated profitability reporting and analytics tools.
  • Establish and document data governance practices, report logic, KPI definitions, and process documentation to enable repeatability and auditability.
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and create one-time dashboards/models for leadership requests.


What are the skills required?

  • Advanced Excel skills (large datasets, pivots, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, data validation, modeling) and ability to work with complex structured data
  • Strong experience with data transformation and modeling using Power Query and Power Pivot (DAX a plus)
  • Experience building dashboards and analytical reporting in Power BI or other BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, etc.)
  • Experience working with Oracle Financials
  • Ability to analyze large datasets, identify trends/outliers, and translate findings into clear business insights
  • Solid understanding of data accuracy concepts: reconciliations, controls, audit trails, and source-to-report validation
  • Hands-on technical skills with SQL (queries, joins, aggregations); VBA is a plus
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong organizational and time management skills; comfortable managing multiple priorities under deadlines
  • Self-starter, detail-oriented, process improvement mindset; ability to document processes and standards
  • Strong understanding of the business, with a proactive approach to identifying and anticipating needs
  • Effective use of task organization and prioritization tools is essential, including Kanban, sprint planning, and other Agile practices
  • Advanced/fluent oral and written English
  • Availability to work from the office in hybrid mode


Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in data analytics, reporting, business operations, or finance analytics
  • Proven experience building automated reporting solutions, dashboards, and KPI tracking
  • Experience supporting forecasting/actuals cycles and working with financial/operational metrics (bookings, revenue, margin, profitability)
  • Experience working with ERP systems and extracting/transforming data from multiple sources
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
  • Hands-on experience with Power Query / Power Pivot / Power BI
  • Hands-on experience in SQL and/or VBA; exposure to big data tools is a plus
  • Experience using Oracle Financials
  • Experience in multinational software/services environment is a plus


Education

  • BS in Finance/Accounting/Business/Analytics (or related)

title: LLM Application Engineer
description:
The Role

You'll join the AI Products squad to build the next generation of LLM-powered applications for the staffing industry. This is a product engineering role, not a research role. You'll ship real AI products used by real recruiters and real clients.

We're not looking for someone who trains models from scratch. We're looking for someone who knows how to build with LLMs — orchestrating agents, designing RAG pipelines, crafting prompt architectures, and shipping applications that solve real business problems. If you've built a chatbot, an agent, or a RAG app that actually went to production (or close to it), we want to talk.

.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build agentic systems — multi-step AI workflows that reason, retrieve, and act across multiple tools and data sources
  • Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines — connect LLMs to company data through vector databases, semantic search, and context injection
  • Craft prompt architectures — design system prompts, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought patterns, and guardrails for production LLM applications
  • Integrate with APIs and data sources — consume data from our CDI platform (Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse), ATS (JobDiva), VMS platforms, and internal systems
  • Ship production-grade applications — not prototypes. Build with error handling, monitoring, logging, fallback strategies, and user-facing quality
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform squad — define what data you need in what format, and work with data engineers to make AI-ready datasets available
  • Evaluate and iterate on AI quality — build evaluation frameworks, test edge cases, measure accuracy, and improve outputs systematically
  • Stay current with the LLM ecosystem — new models, frameworks, and techniques ship weekly. You'll help evaluate what's worth adopting.


What We're Looking For

Must have (1-3 years of experience):

  • Shipped at least one LLM-powered application in a real organization (not just personal projects or tutorials). This could be a chatbot, agent, RAG app, content generator, or similar.
  • Strong Python skills — you think in Python, not just write it
  • Hands-on experience with LLM orchestration frameworks — LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or similar
  • Experience building RAG systems — vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS), embedding models, retrieval strategies, context window management
  • Understanding of prompt engineering at a production level — not just getting good outputs, but building reliable, consistent, testable prompt architectures
  • Familiarity with LLM APIs — OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or open-source model serving (Ollama, vLLM)
  • Basic understanding of software engineering practices — Git, API design, error handling, logging
  • Good communication in English (daily collaboration with a distributed team)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with agent frameworks — multi-agent orchestration, tool use, function calling, planning loops
  • Familiarity with fine-tuning LLMs (LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning) — not required but valuable for future work
  • Experience with evaluation frameworks for LLM outputs (RAGAS, custom metrics, human-in-the-loop evaluation)
  • Knowledge of NLP fundamentals — text classification, NER, semantic similarity, embeddings
  • Exposure to cloud deployment — Azure, AWS, or GCP for hosting AI services
  • Familiarity with staffing, HR tech, or recruiting industry — understanding placement lifecycles, compliance, credentialing
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric , Power BI , or Azure ecosystem


Why This Role

  • Build AI products at scale from day one. Our data infrastructure covers millions of candidates, Fortune 500 clients. The problems are real and the impact is immediate.
  • Full product ownership. You won't be writing prompt templates in a vacuum. You'll own products end-to-end: architecture, data requirements, prompt design, API integration, quality, and iteration.
  • Cutting-edge stack. LLMs, agents, RAG, vector databases, agentic workflows — all in production, not demos.
  • Growth trajectory. As the team scales toward an AI Products Squad (2-3 engineers), early joiners will shape the team culture and grow into lead roles.

title: RippleX Partner Director
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

Are you a strategic leader with deep experience in relationship management and a passion for tokenization, institutional finance, and blockchain technology? As a Partner Director on the RippleX Partner Success team, you'll play a key role in accelerating the growth and impact of the XRPL ecosystem. You will serve as a trusted advisor to a portfolio of high-profile partners—including financial institutions, fintechs, and crypto-native builders—guiding them through every stage of their journey: from idea to integration to go-live and scale.

This is not a passive role. You will be hands-on in shaping tokenization strategies, architecting utility on-chain, and removing roadblocks in dynamic, high-stakes environments. Your day-to-day will span deep technical discussions and executive-level strategic planning—always with the goal of maximizing partner success and driving meaningful, on-ledger activity.

If you're excited to unlock real-world utility through tokenized assets and thrive at the intersection of institutional finance and blockchain innovation, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Own and lead a portfolio of highly strategic and complex Institutional DeFi partners building on XRPL, with a focus on scaled adoption of tokenized asset use cases.
  • Define and drive strategic account plans that maximize long-term value for both Ripple and its partners.
  • Lead execution across technical and GTM workstreams, anticipating risks and aligning cross-functional resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Provide thought leadership and guidance to partners around tokenization, utility, regulatory considerations, and financial market structures.
  • Build and maintain strong executive relationships with C-level stakeholders at partner organizations, and act as a senior voice across Ripple internal teams.
  • Represent partner needs and priorities internally, influencing RippleX’s roadmap, product strategy, and go-to-market motions.
  • Identify opportunities for broader ecosystem impact and partner cross-collaboration to accelerate XRPL utility.
  • Travel to partner and customer sites as needed (20–30%).

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 10–12+ years of experience leading strategic partnerships or enterprise engagements in fintech, financial services, or blockchain—ideally with a focus on innovation and emerging tech.
  • Institutional Finance Acumen: Deep understanding of financial instruments and market structure (equities, bonds, repos, collateralized lending, etc.). Strong grasp of collateral management, capital efficiency, and how DeFi can impact these processes. Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (Basel III, MiFID, EMIR, etc.) and how they relate to tokenisation and digital asset adoption
  • Tokenization Expertise: Strong command of tokenization models, use cases, and best practices. Able to influence strategy and guide partner implementation across the asset lifecycle.
  • Blockchain Fluency: Deep understanding of blockchain fundamentals and how they can be applied to financial use cases such as tokenization, settlement, and collateral management. Ability to evaluate different protocol features (e.g., scalability, finality, cost, security) and articulate how they impact institutional DeFi applications. Experience advising on interoperability protocols and bridging technologies (e.g., Axelar) to support cross-chain integration and ecosystem connectivity.
  • Go-to-Market & Utility Creation: Proven track record of launching scalable GTM strategies that result in sustained on-chain activity and partner adoption. Ability to cross-pollinate within Ripple and across partners.
  • Partner Enablement & Growth: Extensive experience leading strategic partnerships and enterprise relationships, with a focus on enabling partners from ideation through to build, compliance readiness, and scaled deployment. Adept at managing complex stakeholder dynamics across technical, product, and executive functions. Proven ability to proactively remove obstacles and shape partner strategy to drive momentum, unlock long-term value, and deliver measurable impact on ecosystem growth.
  • Problem Solving with Agency: Bias for action and proactive problem solving, especially when navigating ambiguity or institutional inertia. Strong “ownership mindset” to help partners go from idea to deployment with confidence. Strategic thinker with a proactive mindset—skilled at managing through ambiguity, resolving friction, and anticipating downstream impact.
  • Executive Presence & Trust Building: Experienced engaging at the C-suite level at tier 1 banks and asset managers, with credibility, empathy, and strategic insight. Trusted advisor in high-stakes conversations. Skilled in managing sensitive conversations (regulatory risk, commercial conflicts, etc.).
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Comfortable driving alignment and influencing roadmaps across multiple internal teams to ensure success at scale.

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.

O Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.

Seu papel será garantir que as lojas parceiras entendam, usem e se beneficiem do nosso marketplace, fortalecendo nossa presença em campo, ofertando as indústrias participantes e trazendo aprendizados para dentro de casa.

  • Tirar dúvidas sobre campanhas, regras e funcionalidades;
  • Apoiar as indústrias e distribuidores parceiros localmente, sendo um ponto de contato estratégico e confiável;
  • Trazer feedbacks e insights valiosos do campo para apoiar o time de produto, marketing e operações;
  • Colaborar com times internos na ativação de novos sellers do marketplace;
  • Monitorar tendências do varejo e concorrência na região;
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com donos, gerentes e vendedores — somos uma marca próxima e presente!

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia em área comercial (presencial);
  • Boa comunicação e escuta ativa — você vai lidar com muitos perfis diferentes;
  • Organização para lidar com uma carteira diversa e realizar visitas diárias;
  • Interesse genuíno em aprender sobre o setor de material de construção (experiência prévia é um plus!);
  • Perfil mão na massa, que resolve, propõe e faz acontecer;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens dentro da região;
  • Ensino superior em andamento ou concluído (Administração, Marketing, Comércio Exterior ou áreas afins);
  • CNH válida e Excel no mínimo intermediário.

  • Conhecimento prévio em marketplace B2B;
  • Ter atuado com rotina externa e visitas diárias;
  • Ter facilidade para apresentar, treinar e engajar clientes.

Você vai trabalhar em um programa que conecta varejo, indústria e tecnologia para transformar um dos setores mais importantes do país — e fazer isso com autonomia, responsabilidade e muita troca. Aqui, a gente valoriza quem constrói junto, compartilha aprendizados e busca soluções com propósito.

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.

Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Analista de BI Pleno
description:
* VENHA SER ANALISTA DE BI NA TELADOC HEALTH"

Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!

A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados, está buscando Analista de BI Pleno , para atuar em sua área de Estratégia e Novos Negócios! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência, apaixonado por desafios, proativo no olhar sobre as necessidades dos clientes, venha fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, pois esta é sua oportunidade!

* SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *

A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta, conhecimento técnico da melhor equipe de Médicos, Especialistas, Psicólogos, Nutricionistas, Enfermeiros e Educadores Físicos, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.

* O QUE PROCURAMOS: *

Você administrar e manter em funcionamento dos banco de dados da empresa, utilizando as melhores práticas de mercado aplicáveis tecnicamente ao gerenciamento de banco de dados em uso na organização. Coletar, tratar, estruturar e analisar os dados da empresa provenientes do backend médico, garantindo organização, padronização e consistência das informações no BigQuery.

Estruturar uma camada analítica confiável para consumo, permitindo visibilidade dos indicadores operacionais e estratégicos para uso interno e, posteriormente, para clientes.

Transformar dados brutos em informação estruturada, garantindo qualidade, estabilidade e alinhamento das métricas oficiais da empresa.

*DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES*:

  • Compreender a estrutura dos dados recebidos via API e organizar os datasets no BigQuery (raw, staging e camada analítica);
  • Padronizar nomenclaturas, tipos de dados, chaves e regras de negócio garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade das informações;
  • Modelar e manter views analíticas e tabelas agregadas para consumo no Looker;
  • Garantir qualidade dos dados através de validações básicas (duplicidades, nulos, integridade e consistência entre tabelas);
  • Definir e manter atualizado o dicionário de métricas/KPIs como fonte única de verdade;
  • Otimizar queries no BigQuery visando performance e eficiência de processamento;
  • Criar e manter dashboards no Looker baseados na camada analítica estruturada;
  • Automatizar rotinas recorrentes de consolidação e preparação de relatórios;
  • Apoiar na preparação de indicadores mensais internos;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com estagiário de BI orientando atividades operacionais relacionadas a dashboards e validações básicas;
  • Detectar e comunicar inconsistências ou falhas de dados à área de tecnologia quando necessário;
  • Manter organização e versionamento das queries e transformações realizadas.
  • Oferecer suporte durante apresentações para clientes, quando necessário;
  • Prestar suporte para demais atividade correlacionadas ao cargo e apoio ao superior imediato;

*REQUISITOS*

Formação Acadêmica:

Ensino Superior – Sistema de Informação, Engenharia(s), Matemática, Estatística, Ciência de Dados ou cursos relacionados à área tecnológica.

Idiomas:

Inglês Intermediário

Experiência Desejada/Ideal:

Ter atuado com análise de dados por 2 a 4 anos com análise de dados.

Conhecimentos Específicos:

• SQL avançado (joins complexos, CTEs, window functions);

• Experiência prática com BigQuery;

• Experiência com Looker ou ferramenta similar;

• Conhecimento de modelagem analítica e conceitos de Data Warehouse;

• Experiência com dados estruturados e semiestruturados (ex: JSON);

• Prática em definição e acompanhamento de métricas/KPIs;

• Noções de versionamento (Git é diferencial);

• Conhecimento básico de Python é diferencial.

Competências Comportamentais e Atitudes Desejadas:

• Alta confiabilidade e previsibilidade de entrega;

• Organização e disciplina operacional;

• Comunicação verbal e escrita clara;

• Proatividade na identificação de inconsistências;

• Compromisso com prazos e qualidade;

• Capacidade de trabalhar com autonomia técnica;

• Foco em melhoria contínua.

*BENEFÍCIOS E CONTRATAÇÃO:*

  • Plano de Saúde Bradesco - 100% custeado pela empresa;
  • VA/VR 100% custeado pela empresa;
  • Plano Odontológico 100% custeado pela empresa;
  • Contratação CLT;
  • Modelo Híbrido de Trabalho (Local: Av Berrini, SP), com presença no Escritório a combinar;
  • Birthday Off;
  • Kit Natal;
  • Dia da Enfermagem Off (1 dia/Ano)
  • Salário: a combinar
  • Horário: Segunda à Sexta.
  • Auxílio Creche (de acordo com política);
  • Frutas no escritório.

E você, quer fazer a diferença e transformar a saúde de milhares de famílias brasileiras com a gente?

Quer fazer parte de um time inovador dentro da maior empresa de saúde da América do Sul?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de RH - HR Business Partner (HRBP) com experiência generalista nos subsistemas de RH e perfil consultivo para atuar de forma estratégica.

A posição atua como ponte entre liderança e time, conectando as necessidades do negócio às dos profissionais. Garante consistência de gestão e desenvolvimento, fortalece cultura e engajamento, alinhando performance e resultados.

O profissional terá atuação transversal, apoiando diferentes frentes na unidade de negócio. Contribuirá para o planejamento das áreas e para a evolução de processos e práticas de Pessoas & Cultura, com foco em eficiência operacional e na qualidade da experiência do colaborador, com forte habilidade em leitura de dados e cenários. ✨

Principais requisitos / O que você precisa ter:

- Formação: Administração, Psicologia, Gestão de RH, Engenharias ou áreas correlatas;

-Experiência prévia como HRBP ou atuação generalista com perfil estratégico.

-Vivência prática em múltiplos subsistemas (ex.: Clima & Cultura, T&D e R&S).

-Capacidade de atuação consultiva e estratégica, com boa leitura de negócio e foco em execução.

-Experiência comprovada atuando com times em níveis de senioridade diferentes.

-Forte habilidade de comunicação, escuta ativa, influência e relacionamento interpessoal.

-Capacidade de atuar com visão de negócio (prioridades, linguagem empresarial, métricas e impacto).

-Familiaridade com orçamento de postos de trabalho e linha de custo de pessoal.

-Organização e priorização para lidar com múltiplas demandas e stakeholders.

Dia-a-dia / aqui você vai:

-Atuar como parceiro (a) das lideranças, apoiando decisões e rotinas de gestão de pessoas (estrutura, desempenho, desenvolvimento, movimentações, rituais e cultura).

-Mapear necessidades das áreas e transformá-las em planos e ações alinhadas aos objetivos do negócio.

-Planejar e conduzir iniciativas de clima, cultura, engajamento e experiência do colaborador, promovendo um ambiente saudável e de alta performance.

-Planejar e conduzir ações de Treinamento Desenvolvimento (levantamento de necessidades, trilhas, programas, rituais e acompanhamento);

-Liderar a comunicação interna, conectando áreas e frentes de negócio, promovendo transparência, alinhamento e engajamento.

Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e liderar iniciativas de padronização e otimização de processos de RH, visando eficiência, clareza e governança.

O que oferecemos:

•Remuneração: Salário compatível + Benefícios + Bônus;

•Local de trabalho: Presencial - Hospital Quinta D'Or - São Cristóvão/RJ;

title: Technical Lead
description:
About Phi Partners

Phi Partners is the a market leader for capital markets technology services providing technology & quant services, solutions, and expertise to buy-side and sell-side financial institutions including some of the world’s largest investment banks, hedge funds and asset management firms. Founded in 2004 and headquartered in London, Phi has a presence in all major continents. Our niche focus on Front Office Technology has been a differentiator and gateway into the world’s best financial institutions.

About Phi Partners Brazil

Phi Partners has nearshore Centres-of-Excellence which are specialized in respective ‘Lines of Business’ (LoBs). Our latest São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence, houses our Quant, Front Office & Risk Technology Services (FORTS) & Murex teams. The São Paulo Centre-of-Excellence was opened with the goal to strengthened Phi's current relationship with our North America clients, as well with global clients with presence in São Paulo. Joining us means diving into truly groundbreaking work, pushing the limits of what modern technology can deliver while solving high-impact challenges for top-tier clients. You’ll build cutting-edge solutions for the world’s largest Investment Banks, leading Asset Managers, and market-defining Hedge Funds, working on projects where innovation is not an extra, but a fundamental expectation in everything we deliver.

About The FORTS Practice

Phi Partners is one of the largest consultancies specializing FORTS, with a dedicated team of over 175 consultants spread across multiple locations. Our team is distinguished by deep expertise in front-office and risk technology solutions, empowering top-tier financial institutions to optimize their trading and risk management capabilities.

At Phi Partners, we are committed to a collaborative, high-performance culture where professionals work together to deliver complex front-office solutions to elite clients. We specialize in the end-to-end implementation of front-office and risk platforms, from initial requirements gathering to post-go-live support, ensuring that our clients are fully supported throughout the platform lifecycle. We focus on custom development and configuration, creating solutions that address unique client needs and regulatory requirements in real-time trading and risk management.

Key Responsibilities

Phi is seeking an experienced an Engineering Manager / Technology Lead to establish and run a local delivery team in São Paulo working on a modern, cloud-native, cross-asset Pricing & Risk platform for a global financial-services client.

This role owns local delivery, team leadership, governance, and quality , allowing the global technical lead to focus on architecture and strategy. The successful candidate will be hands-on, delivery-oriented, and business-aware , with a strong Python-led engineering mindset and experience building and operating distributed systems in regulated environments.

This role gives you the opportunity to:

• Report directly to the Global Engineering & Technology Lead based in London

• Lead the São Paulo delivery team

• Own end-to-end delivery for the São Paulo team across development, testing, release, and BAU support

• Translate high-level architectural direction into practical, incremental delivery plans

• Ensure delivery against agreed milestones, quality standards, and non-functional requirements

• Act as the local point of accountability for delivery outcomes

• Own engineering governance , including:

• Code quality and review practices

• Testing strategy and coverage

• CI/CD and release discipline

• Documentation and operational readiness

• Ensure solutions meet security, resilience, and auditability expectations typical of Pricing & Risk systems

• Proactively identify and mitigate delivery and operational risks

• Remain technically engaged , contributing where appropriate (design reviews, complex debugging, critical path work)

• Act as a trusted local interface to client technology and business stakeholders

The Ideal candidate

Essential

• Proven experience as an Engineering Manager, Technology Lead , or similar role

• Strong hands-on engineering background, ideally with Python as a primary language

• Experience leading small to mid-sized development teams in a delivery-focused environment

• Demonstrated ownership of delivery, quality, and governance , not just design

• Experience building or operating cloud-native platforms

• Strong communication skills and confidence engaging with business and technical stakeholders

• Fluent English (spoken and written)

Highly Desirable

• Experience in capital markets, pricing, risk, trading, or market data systems

• Prior experience working with distributed or international teams

• Background in regulated or high-reliability environment

• Exposure to cross-asset systems or analytics platforms

Why should you join Phi Parnters

Join us as we build the next-generation team, an ambitious, fast-growing group delivering world-class, complex, and genuinely exciting projects to major financial institutions around the globe. We’re in a pivotal expansion phase, working with leading-edge technologies and giving you the chance to shape our strategy, influence key architectural decisions, and deploy solutions that truly impact global Capital Markets. This is a rare opportunity to be part of a world-leading Capital Markets Technology Consultancy while working alongside one of the strongest banking organizations in the industry.

title: Information Technology Portfolio Manager
description:
Job Title: IT Portfolio Manager

Job Type: 12-Month Contract

Job Location: Tampa, FL (Remote)

Role Summary

The Delivery Portfolio Manager is accountable for the end-to-end performance of a portfolio of delivery initiatives (digital, operational, or transformation), ensuring they are strategically aligned, properly funded, forecasted, governed, and executed. This role sits at the intersection of delivery leadership and financial management; owning portfolio-level budgeting, forecasting, variance management, investment governance, and benefits tracking while providing leaders with decision-ready transparency on what our customer is getting for its investment.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy, Intake & Prioritization

  • Translate our client’s business priorities into a coherent portfolio roadmap and sequencing plan across initiatives and value streams.
  • Operate a structured intake/demand process that connects ideas to funded work with clear outcomes and sponsors.
  • Facilitate prioritization using value, risk, compliance, capacity, and funding constraints; recommend start/stop/continue actions.

Financial Management & Investment Governance (Core of Role)

  • Own portfolio financials across CAPEX/OPEX (and where applicable, capitalization policy alignment), including annual planning and rolling reforecasting.
  • Maintain a portfolio financial “system of truth,” including budget vs. actuals, burn rate, run vs. change, and forecast accuracy.
  • Perform variance root cause analysis and surface financial risks (scope creep, vendor overrun, dependency delays) with mitigation options.
  • Support governance rhythms (e.g., Quarterly Planning Events) ensuring initiatives have clear lean business cases, cost drivers, measurable outcomes, and owners.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, and initiative leaders to enforce controls, transparency, and compliance expectations consistent with our customer’s integrity and records standards.

Delivery Oversight & Portfolio Health

  • Provide portfolio-level oversight across multiple teams, tracking delivery confidence, milestones, dependencies, risks, quality, and readiness to deploy.
  • Establish lightweight governance that improves throughput and decision velocity, without slowing delivery.
  • Drive early escalation with clear options and tradeoffs across scope, schedule, cost, and quality.

Capacity, Resource & Portfolio Planning

  • Build portfolio capacity plans aligned to demand, proactively surface bottlenecks and cost impacts.
  • Ensure vendor investments align to portfolio outcomes, budgets, and controls in our customer’s global operating context.

Benefits Realization & Value Tracking

  • Define value measures for initiatives (OKRs/KPIs) and establish baselines, track benefits delivery and realization over time.
  • Make benefits visible post-delivery—identify drift between expected and realized outcomes and drive corrective action.

Reporting & Transparency

  • Deliver crisp, decision-ready reporting on portfolio performance (delivery + financial), top risks/dependencies, and investment tradeoffs with recommendations.
  • Build trust through “no surprises” reporting aligned to our customer’s culture of integrity and responsible stewardship.
  • Safety, Risk & Integrity
  • Ensure portfolio governance respects our customer’s expectations for health, safety, ethical conduct, and accurate records.
  • Promote a speak-up culture and proactively manage delivery risks that could impact operational integrity, compliance, or stakeholder trust.

Required Qualifications

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in IT portfolio delivery management with direct accountability for budgeting, forecasting, and investment governance.
  • Demonstrated strength in financial modeling, variance analysis, and forecasting.
  • Experience operating in a large organization with global stakeholders and multiple business segments.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and portfolio reporting (Power BI strongly preferred).
  • Experience working with Agile, Scrum, and Kanban

description:
Sobre Nós (A Cultura Zahil)

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Acreditamos que o vinho é capaz de conectar pessoas e criar momentos únicos.

O Perfil que Buscamos

Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada negócio como uma oportunidade de construir uma parceria duradoura. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia , gerir sua carteira de clientes e a criatividade para inovar dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Características que nos inspiram:

  • Mentalidade analítica: Usa dados para fundamentar decisões criativas e montar cartas de vinho estratégicas.
  • Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo (cliente, mercado, concorrência) antes de agir.
  • Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente e se reinventa conforme as necessidades do mercado e dos clientes.
  • Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades (do restaurante, do hotel) e propõe soluções de portfólio e serviço.
  • Resiliência: Transforma os desafios da negociação e do dia a dia em oportunidades de crescimento.

Descrição do Cargo

O(A) Consultor(a) de Vendas Off-Trade é uma peça-chave na estratégia da Zahil em São Paulo. Ele(a) é responsável por construir e gerenciar relacionamentos com os principais mercados e lojas da cidade.

A função exige uma prospecção ativa e uma gestão de carteira inteligente, é preciso agilidade para navegar no dinâmico mercado de São Paulo. Flexibilidade, capacidade de improvisação e vontade de aprender constantemente. O objetivo é ser um parceiro estratégico para o cliente garantindo visibilidade e o crescimento mútuo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar uma carteira de clientes Off-Trade em São Paulo, fortalecendo o relacionamento e identificando oportunidades.
  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes com perfil estratégico para o portfólio Zahil.
  • Analisar o portfólio dos clientes e apresentar os rótulos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença, considerando "pricing" e perfil do estabelecimento.
  • Negociar a inclusão de novos rótulos, ações de visibilidade e condições comerciais.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos clientes (volume, mix de produtos) e propor ações para atingir as metas.
  • Transmitir à gerência as dificuldades, demandas do mercado (concorrência, preços) e oportunidades que ultrapassem sua autonomia.
  • Apoiar no uso dos sistemas internos de CRM (para gestão do funil) e de faturamento (para colocação de pedidos).

Qualificações e Experiência

  • Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa.
  • Cursos: Curso de vinhos técnico ou de extensão (WSET, ABS, etc.) é fundamental.
  • Idiomas: Desejável inglês ou espanhol
  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de três anos em vendas B2B, com experiência comprovada no canal Off-Trade de bebidas (especialmente vinhos).
  • Networking: Um relacionamento ativo e uma carteira pré-existente será um grande diferencial.
  • Habilidades: Forte capacidade de negociação, comunicação, organização e perfil "hunter" (caçador).

Remuneração:

  • Regime CLT: R$ 4.500,00 (quatro mil e quinhentos) de salário fixo + comissão mensal

title: Senior Ecosystem Growth Manager
description:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

THE WORK:

We’re building the next phase of real-world adoption on the XRP Ledger, and LATAM is a critical part of that journey. As Senior Ecosystem Growth Manager for LATAM, you’ll partner with builders, founders, and institutions to expand how tokenized assets are used across payments, trade finance, and collateral management.

Together, we’ll grow a durable ecosystem by connecting startups, venture capital, and strategic partners across LATAM’s FinTech and TradFi landscape, while navigating the region’s diverse regulatory environments. This is a strategic yet hands-on role blending ecosystem development, partnerships, and go-to-market execution.

You will be responsible for the rollout of ecosystem growth programs, supporting emerging startups from inception to mainnet launch, and improving our standing in the region. Navigating LATAM’s diverse regulatory landscape, you will form a robust network of startup programs, venture capital firms, and ecosystem players.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Complete and put into action ecosystem growth strategy for XRPL, adapted to local regulatory and market conditions
  • Discover, evaluate, and support high-potential startups and developers building on XRPL
  • Build meaningful alliances with accelerators, VCs, FinTech, and ecosystem service providers
  • Structure partnership agreements built to drive balanced ecosystem growth
  • Guide startups from early-stage concept through successful mainnet deployment
  • Review grant and accelerator applications, assessing founder quality, product potential, and ecosystem fit
  • Facilitate introductions to partners, resources, and growth opportunities
  • Provide ongoing support to portfolio companies to help accelerate their growth trajectory
  • Build and lead top-of-funnel pipelines through targeted programs, grants, and direct outreach, while identifying emerging trends, new growth partners, and institutional channels across LATAM
  • Work closely with DevRel, Partner Engineering, Product, and Product Marketing, you’ll help shape go-to-market strategies & iterate based on ecosystem performance and market feedback
  • Supervise regulatory developments and assess their impact on tokenization and digital asset adoption
  • Use data and strategic narratives to influence cross-functional collaborators
  • Pressure-test growth strategies and provide thoughtful tradeoff analysis across challenging priorities
  • Anticipate market obstacles and recommend scalable, innovative solutions

WHAT YOU'LL BRING: 

  • 5–8 years in venture capital, ecosystem partnerships, FinTech or TradFi growth, or related roles
  • Proven track record in structuring and leading partnerships with early-stage teams or strategic collaborators
  • Experience operating across markets with diverse regulatory and business environments
  • Strong growth and metrics fluency, including funnel optimization and partnership performance benchmarking
  • Technical understanding sufficient to engage product and infrastructure teams on feasibility assessments
  • Solid understanding of financial instruments, market structure, and regulatory frameworks
  • Familiarity with tokenization trends, DeFi protocols, and their intersection with traditional finance
  • Clear, influential communicator with strong relationship-building skills
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity with autonomy and accountability
  • Data-guided approach to measuring and improving ecosystem growth initiatives 

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

Benefits listed above are for full-time employees. 

Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.   Please find our UK/EU Applicant Privacy Notice and our California Applicant Privacy Notice for reference.

title: IT Operations Manager
description:
We are the Americas Cluster Operations Team, a critical component of a leading global technology enterprise's infrastructure strategy. Our mission is to ensure the highly efficient, stable, and secure operation of the operational environment across the Americas. Our team comprises dedicated professionals in Facilities, IT, and Asset Management, deeply experienced in large-scale system operations, possessing comprehensive capabilities from daily operations to strategic planning:Facilities Team: Responsible for 24x7 uninterrupted operations and emergency response of critical physical support systems within the large operational environment, including electrical, HVAC, and fire suppression. We ensure physical environment stability and sustainable operations through rigorous capacity management and energy efficiency optimization.IT Team: Manages the full lifecycle operations of IT equipment like servers and networks within the operational environment. We ensure high SLA compliance for IT services through proactive systemic risk governance, automation, and process optimization, while leading various technology upgrade projects.Asset Team: Oversees the full lifecycle management and governance of IT assets. We ensure asset compliance, visibility, and efficient utilization through precise data management, risk control, and cost-efficiency strategies.Our Core Focuses:End-to-End Reliability: From physical support to IT services, we provide comprehensive stability assurance, focused on mitigating risks and ensuring business continuity.Project-Based & Lean Operations: We approach operational work through a project lens, continuously optimizing processes to achieve efficient resource utilization and lean operating costs.Innovation & Talent Development: We actively integrate cutting-edge technologies and foster robust knowledge-sharing mechanisms to continuously enhance our team's professional capabilities and innovative practices.We serve as the robust foundation for the enterprise's business growth in the Americas, providing powerful and trustworthy infrastructure assurance through professionalism, innovation, and collaboration.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Responsible for the comprehensive operation and maintenance management of IT infrastructure (including but not limited to servers, networks, storage, and related software platforms) within large-scale operational environments in the Americas region.

2. Develop and implement IT operation strategies, procedures, and standards (SOPs) to ensure the efficient, stable, and secure operation of IT systems, in compliance with internal and external regulations.

3. Manage the IT operations team, including recruitment, training, performance evaluation, team development, and daily management, to enhance team professionalism and efficiency.

4. Lead IT incident management, event response, change management, and problem-solving processes to ensure high availability and business continuity of IT systems.

5. Drive the IT operations' transformation towards automation and intelligence, introducing advanced technologies and tools to continuously optimize operational processes, efficiency, and quality.

6. Responsible for IT infrastructure capacity planning, performance monitoring, and optimization to ensure resource allocation meets business growth demands.

7. Manage IT-related vendors and third-party service providers, ensuring their service quality and SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance.

8. Responsible for IT operations budget planning, cost control, and analysis of technology investment returns.

9. Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Facilities, Asset Management, Security, Business Units) to ensure IT operations effectively support overall business objectives.

10. Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies, supporting the evolution of IT architecture to enhance technological competitiveness.

Job Requirements:

1. Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Electronic Information Engineering, or a related IT professional field.

2. Over 5 years of experience in large-scale IT system operation and maintenance management, with at least 3 years in a team management role; experience in multinational corporations is a plus.

3. In-depth understanding and practical experience with server hardware, operating systems (Linux/Windows), network technologies (TCP/IP, routing & switching), and storage systems.

4. Familiar with ITIL/ITSM management frameworks, possessing excellent capabilities in ITIL process implementation and optimization.

5. Practical experience with IT automation and intelligent operation tools (e.g., scripting languages, monitoring systems, configuration management tools).

6. Excellent team leadership, project management, and risk management capabilities.

7. Outstanding communication, coordination, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, capable of handling complex technical and managerial issues.

8. Strong English reading, writing, and communication skills, able to communicate effectively as a working language.

9. (Plus) Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CCIE/CCNP, RHCE are a plus.

10. (Plus) Experience in cloud platform operations or DevOps practices is a plus.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER COMO ESPECIALISTA DE GOVERNO E MINERIA DE PROCESSOS I:

  • Gestão do portfólio de necessidades : assegurar visão end-to-end dos processos impactados e alinhamento sistêmico em toda a MAPFRE.
  • Planos de ação : estruturar, monitorar e garantir execução com foco em prazos, custos, entregas, riscos e impactos.

  • Gestão de processos : mapear, modelar e normatizar fluxos; apoiar áreas na mitigação de riscos e aproveitamento de oportunidades.
  • Cultura de processos : promover gestão por processos e disseminar boas práticas na companhia.
  • Monitoramento e reporting : consolidar e reportar evolução das iniciativas com precisão e tempestividade; apresentar status executivos para tomada de decisão.
  • Gestão documental : assegurar repositório único e controlado de documentos, artefatos e evidências.
  • Comunicação executiva : coordenar comunicações sobre impactos, prazos e entregas-chave, reforçando consciência organizacional e responsabilidade regulatória.

O QUE A MAPFRE ESPERA DE VOCÊ

  • Ferramentas de fluxograma (Visio,Bizagi, Aris, Miro, etc);

  • Desejável conhecimento em: BPMS/BPM|EPC|PDCA|6'S|Workout |Ishikawa |Kanban | PMI | SCRUM
  • Formato híbrido: 3 X2
  • Local de trabalho: Zona Sul (São Paulo)

Nossos benefícios para você

A MAPFRE é feita de pessoas, por isso retribuímos da melhor maneira possível o comprometimento de nossos colaboradores, que contam com:

  • A jornada diária conta com horário flexível, formato de trabalho híbrido;

  • Disponibilização de cursos e treinamentos presenciais e E-learning em nossa plataforma digital, a Universidade Corporativa MAPFRE.
  • A Assessoria do Programa Viva Leve está sempre aberta para ouvir via atendimento 0800 com psicólogos, assistentes sociais, orientações de nutricionistas, fisioterapeutas, além de consultoria Pet e orientações com profissionais da área jurídica.

Nos importamos com o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores e para isso, trabalhamos programas que promovem mobilidade, desenvolvimento, oportunidades de carreira e crescimento profissional. Mais do que apoiar, celebramos cada conquista!

title: CRO & Shopify Developer
description:
CRO & Shopify Developer

  • Full time contractor
  • £22-32k per year (depending on experience).
  • Bonus structure on performance

About PM Digital

PM Digital is The full-funnel CRO & Performance agency for 7, 8, and 9-figure DTC brands. We optimise & fix entire funnels. Our focus is increasing profitability for ecommerce brands and you are part of this through the CRO split testing and Shopify development for our client stores.

About the Role

We're looking for a CRO & Shopify Developer to join one of our pods. You'll work alongside CRO strategists, designers, and copywriters to build high-converting landing pages, implement A/B tests, and bring Figma designs to life in Shopify.

This isn't a "fix bugs and update plugins" role. You'll be building conversion-focused pages from scratch, implementing split tests, and directly impacting revenue for DTC brands spending serious money on paid acquisition.

What You'll Do

  • Build landing pages, PDPs, and funnel pages in Shopify based on Figma designs
  • Implement A/B and multivariate tests using Convert.com and Intelligems
  • Set up price testing, offer testing, and bundle experiments via Intelligems
  • Work within our internal app and processes to ship work on time
  • Translate designer and strategist intent into pixel-perfect, fast-loading pages
  • Ensure all builds are mobile-first, performance-optimised, and QA'd before launch
  • Collaborate daily with your pod (CRO strategist, designer, copywriter)
  • Flag technical limitations or opportunities early — don't wait until it's a problem
  • Document your work clearly so others can maintain and iterate on it

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years Shopify development experience (themes, Liquid, custom sections)
  • ADVANCED use of AI Within your development workflow. Speed is key.
  • Strong HTML, CSS, JavaScript — you can build from scratch, not just edit templates
  • Experience turning Figma designs into production-ready Shopify pages
  • Familiarity with A/B testing platforms (Intelligems, Convert.com, or similar)
  • Understanding of page speed optimisation and Core Web Vitals
  • Comfortable working async in a remote team across time zones
  • Strong written communication, you'll be working with non-developers daily
  • Attention to detail, sloppy work doesn't ship
  • Strong AI Use case to speed up time to delivery

What Success Looks Like

  • Pages go live on time, match the design, and perform well
  • Tests are implemented correctly the first time — no re-work loops
  • You proactively flag issues and suggest better solutions
  • Your pod trusts you to execute without hand-holding

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • Want ownership, not tickets
  • Care about the outcome (revenue), not just the output (code)
  • Move fast and communicate clearly
  • Take pride in clean, maintainable work
  • Want to grow with a high-performance team

You Won't Thrive Here If You:

  • Need constant direction or detailed specs for every task
  • See QA as someone else's problem
  • Struggle with direct feedback
  • Don't hit deadlines

Details

  • Remote (European time zone based)
  • Full-time contractor
  • Salary based on experience - £22-34k BOE

How to Apply

Send a short note on why this role fits you, plus:

  1. Link to 2-3 Shopify websites or experiences you've built (landing pages or custom work preferred)
  2. Brief explanation of a test you implemented and how it performed (if applicable)

Fill in this form after the job role, you will get all your information here.

title: Upper Grades Math Teacher
description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

WHY TEACH AT AVENUES?

Avenues | The World School prepares students for engaged global citizenship during a time of unprecedented complexity and accelerating change, combining language immersion, interdisciplinary learning, a global curriculum, and a culture of creativity and deep collaboration.

DEEP COLLABORATION, CONSTANT EVOLUTION

Collaboration here isn't a buzzword: it's woven into everything we do. At Avenues, no one teaches on an island. Substantial time to collaborate is embedded into the schedule. Teacher teams design learning experiences together. This intensity of collaboration is challenging as well as exciting: we're always evolving, learning from each other and seeking to improve.

SECONDARY DIVISION

The Middle and Upper Grades are where our ambitious goals for Avenues graduates, defined in our mission statement , are most comprehensively realized. While in grades 6-12, we prepare students for a globally connected, innovation-driven, and largely unknown future. Our students will be: accomplished in all the academic skills you would expect, at ease beyond their borders, and confident because they excel in a particular passion.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Avenues uses a problem-based mathematics pedagogy and curriculum. Math in Middle/Upper grades is taught through a student centered approach, where students discuss to find their solutions, continually reflect on mistakes and master mathematical concepts through working out problems together. Teachers facilitate discourse in class to guide students to deeper understanding of mathematics. You will also:

● Ensure that students achieve key learning outcomes, targeting instruction to address individual needs

● Build a learning atmosphere that leads students to feel part of a rigorous, dynamic, and joyful learning community

● Collaborate intensively with colleagues to continually deepen student learning

● Inspire trust and confidence among parents and families

Start date: July 2026

Qualifications

Math teachers at Avenues bring all or most of the following:

● A remarkable entrepreneurial drive, creativity and ability to bring new ideas to fruition

● Intellectual curiosity and humility, to reflect on and continually grow in teaching practice

● Strong content knowledge in math

● Pedagogy that engages all students in interesting, meaningful and challenging work

● Experience teaching math, with clear evidence of student learning and growth

● A strong sense of personal responsibility for the success of every student

Additional Information

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

Avenues upholds the highest standards for safeguarding the physical and emotional wellbeing of children. As an essential aspect of this commitment, all offers are contingent upon successful completion of careful reference and background checks.

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

title: Tech Lead / Staff Software Engineer (AI Platform)
description:
Job Title: Tech Lead / Staff Software Engineer (AI Platform) / Remote Role

About Iron Mountain Iron Mountain is a global leader in information management, present in over 50 countries. In Brazil, we are undergoing a massive technological expansion to build the future of AI. If you are an experienced software engineer looking to move away from legacy maintenance and into the front lines of GenAI innovation, this is your place.

The Challenge In this role, you won't just be an "integrator." You will be part of the Core Engineering team, reporting directly to global leadership in the US. Your mission is to build from scratch the Agentic AI infrastructure and AI-Ready data platforms for our DXP product.

Why is this the ideal next step for your career?

  • AI Pivot: We do not require you to come from a Machine Learning background. We are looking for your solid engineering foundation; we will teach you how to build global-scale AI platforms.
  • Pure Creation (Greenfield): 100% new feature development and innovation. No legacy migrations or old system support.
  • Global Scope: Daily collaboration with engineering teams in the US, Canada, Europe, and India.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities (50/30/20 Split)

  • 50% Hands-on Development: Deep dive into code using Java (JVM) or Golang to create high-performance backend services.
  • 30% Architecture and Design: Lead complex technical discussions, evaluate scalability, and ensure the system design supports AI demands.
  • 20% Technical Mentorship: Act as the technical reference for 2-3 junior engineers in the Americas, performing code reviews and ensuring standards of excellence.

What we are looking for (Mandatory Requirements)

  • Solid Systems Engineering Experience: You must be a "Core" developer who enjoys building services from the ground up.
  • Technical Mastery: Senior-level proficiency in Java (JVM) or Golang .
  • Modern Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Cloud environments ( GCP, AWS, or Azure ).
  • Tech Stack: Knowledge of Spring Boot, databases (Postgres/ElasticSearch), messaging (Kafka), and caching (Redis).
  • Advanced English: Ability to participate in technical discussions and meetings with the global team.

Bonus Points (What you will have the opportunity to master here) If you have experience with these topics, that’s great; if not, you will learn them with us:

  • Notions of GenAI (LLMs) and integration with language models.
  • Experience with Vector DBs (vector databases like Pinecone or Milvus).
  • Knowledge of JS frameworks (ReactJS).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Technology or related fields.
  • Innovation mindset and a desire to be at the forefront of Artificial Intelligence.

title: Labeling Artwork Controller
description:
Are you interested in working directly for a single sponsor while having the security and additional career opportunities that working for a global CRO can bring? Our team says it’s the best of both worlds….

ClinChoice is searching for a Labeling & Artwork Controller Consultant for 12 months Contract with possibility of extension to join one of our clients.

ClinChoice is a global full-service CRO with a strong focus on quality, professional development, and supportive culture. As a client-facing role, we are looking for confident candidates with the ability to work independently whilst establishing a high-trust environment with the client’s counterparts.

Job Description

Artwork Controller

Role Summary

The Regional / Senior Artwork Controller is responsible for managing the end-to-end artwork development process (brief → final release) for packaging and labeling components within the region. This role ensures timely delivery of high-quality, compliant artwork by coordinating cross-functional teams and external vendors, while driving process improvements and maintaining operational excellence. This role combines hands-on execution with team supervision.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage the end-to-end artwork development process from initiation through approval and release, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality labeling components.
  • Act as the primary liaison between PMO, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Packaging, Quality, Supply Chain, and external vendors/agencies.
  • Validate briefs for accuracy and completeness; collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve discrepancies.
  • Oversee timelines, resource planning, and progress tracking for multiple concurrent labeling projects.
  • Coordinate review and approval of labeling content and artwork in internal systems, ensuring compliance with regulatory, legal, and corporate standards.
  • Drive process improvements related to artwork development, approval workflows, and digital tools.
  • Investigate Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) as needed.
  • Maintain artwork issue logs and attend escalation meetings to provide updates.
  • Identify inefficiencies and escalate to Hub Leads when required.
  • Participate in content lock meetings to ensure stakeholder alignment.
  • Manage Veraciti system-related issues and escalate appropriately.
  • Suggest and implement technology solutions for artwork and labeling processes.
  • Create, update, and maintain training documentation for systems and processes.
  • Supervise Artwork Controllers to ensure task completion and provide support during peak periods.
  • Onboard new hires on artwork management systems and end-to-end processes; conduct quarterly refreshers on best practices.
  • Provide guidance on escalation channels and support SMEs, Artwork Process Leads, Vendors, and Hub Leads with artwork production deployment.
  • Track and follow up on action items from cross-functional meetings.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and milestones consistently to stakeholders.
  • Attend regional project meetings (Kick-off, Overview, Alignment, Technical with Printer) and provide updates.
  • Share project insights for dashboards and analytics; contribute to KPI reviews and compliance initiatives.
  • Gather requirements for new regional jobs and assess resources requirements and provide job quotations when required.
  • Conduct design-to-press color management assessments and feasibility consultations.
  • Monitor and maintain regional project timelines and costs; anticipate and resolve roadblocks.
  • Address process and executional quality issues; support system and process improvements.
  • Manage ad-hoc artwork-related requests and cascade process/system communications.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Business, Packaging Technology, or related field;
  • 10+ years in labeling design, proofreading, coordination, regulatory, packaging, and project management within consumer health, pharmaceutical, or medical device industries.
  • Strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements for product labeling and packaging.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Hands-on experience with PLM and electronic artwork systems (e.g., Agile, GLAMS, Loftware, Veraciti, Veeva).
  • Expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop, Acrobat Pro).
  • Familiarity with pre-press and print processes (CMYK, Pantone, dielines, bleed, etc.).
  • Skilled in proofreading tools (e.g., TVT, GlobalVision, InformCC) and regulatory content validation.
  • Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent experience in continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • PMP certification or formal project management training is a plus.

title: Supervisor de SAC
description:
A J&T Express é conhecida como uma das maiores empresas do setor de transportes de logística, entrega expressa, armazenamento e cadeia de suprimentos. Estamos presentes em 13 países, como Indonésia, Vietnã, Malásia, Filipinas, Tailândia, Cambodja, Singapura, China, Arábia Saudita, Emirados Árabes Unidos, México e Brasil. Todos os dias fornecemos aos nossos clientes uma experiência de entrega expressa de excelente qualidade e eficiência, altamente confiável, trazendo mais benefícios às pessoas e fazendo com que elas aproveitem as transformações da economia digital. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e propor soluções.

Apoiar a motivação e o engajamento do time.
